title: Anno Arcana
description: This world had been like yours for all of its history, devoid of any and all arcane energies. Fifteen years ago, a deal was struck and a price was paid, and magic began to ferment within the world. Now that seed has fully bloomed, forcing every nation into a rapid scramble to gather as many magical creatures and exotic mystics to their side as they can. A new arms race, and a new era: Anno Arcana.
author: Kate Drwecka
